page.layout: One page of text, centred; below it an imprimatur block with a license line and a signature line, all at full width. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Perlegi hunc librum, cui Titulus, [Præcipuorum Theologiæ Capitum Enchiridion Didacticum] in quo nihil reperio fidei Ecclesiæ Anglicanæ, aut bonis moribus contrarium.
Tho. Grigg. R. in Christo Patri D. Humfr. Episc. Lond. à Sac. Dom.

page.notes: The scan shows a small ornament group in the lower left of the text area and dots, which are not printed text. The date line reads "1664" on its own line; "Ex Æd. Lond." is printed with "Oct." partly obscured, read as "Oct." [?] and the number "12" as printed. The name "Humfr." in the signature line is partly obscured, read as "Humfr." [?]. Marginal stains at the right edge are not text.
